summary: Stantec Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for May 2026, attaching Exhibit 99.1, its Code of Business Conduct policy. This is a routine disclosure of internal governance standards covering ethics, legal compliance, and employee responsibilities. The filing contains no transaction, price terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics related to any special situation. As a periodic report updating corporate policy, it does not fall into any special-situations category such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring. The SEC filing serves as a transparent update to stakeholders on the company's ethical framework.
